question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
-- Final comprehensive seller performance report
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity_sold,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(orev.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN order_reviews orev ON o.order_id = orev.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP)))) / 3600.0 as avg_packing_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pcat.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) as category_sales,
        COUNT(*) as category_quantity
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcat.product_category_name_english
),
top_category AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english as top_category
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            seller_id,
            product_category_name_english,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_sales DESC) as rn
        FROM seller_category_sales
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_quantity_sold,
    ROUND(sm.total_sales, 2) as total_sales,
    ROUND(sm.avg_item_price, 2) as avg_item_price,
    ROUND(sr.avg_review_score, 2) as avg_review_score,
    ROUND(sp.avg_packing_hours, 2) as avg_packing_hours,
    tc.top_category
FROM seller_metrics sm
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON sm.seller_id = sr.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing sp ON sm.seller_id = sp.seller_id
LEFT JOIN top_category tc ON sm.seller_id = tc.seller_id
ORDER BY sm.total_sales DESC

## Your task

Question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.

orders: index, order_id, customer_id, order_status, order_purchase_timestamp, order_approved_at, order_delivered_carrier_date, order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date

How this database is organised (written by an LLM from the tables' notes and keys):
The orders table links to customers via customer_id, to order_items via order_id, to order_payments via order_id, and to order_reviews via order_id. The order_items table connects to products via product_id and to sellers via seller_id. The order_payments table records individual payment transactions for each order. The order_reviews table stores customer feedback for specific orders. The product_category_name_translation table provides English names for product categories found in the products table. The geolocation table contains geographic coordinates for zip code prefixes. The customers table holds customer identifiers and location data.

function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Build the full seller performance report
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity_sold,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(orev.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN order_reviews orev ON o.order_id = orev.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP)))) / 3600.0 as avg_packing_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pcat.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) as category_sales,
        COUNT(*) as category_quantity
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcat.product_category_name_english
),
top_category AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english as top_category
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            seller_id,
            product_category_name_english,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_sales DESC) as rn
        FROM seller_category_sales
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_quantity_sold,
    ROUND(sm.total_sales, 2) as total_sales,
    ROUND(sm.avg_item_price, 2) as avg_item_price,
    ROUND(sr.avg_review_score, 2) as avg_review_score,
    ROUND(sp.avg_packing_hours, 2) as avg_packing_hours,
    tc.top_category
FROM seller_metrics sm
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON sm.seller_id = sr.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing sp ON sm.seller_id = sp.seller_id
LEFT JOIN top_category tc ON sm.seller_id = tc.seller_id
ORDER BY sm.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 50", "preview_rows": 50}

        COUNT(*) as total_quantity_sold,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(orev.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN order_reviews orev ON o.order_id = orev.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP)))) / 3600.0 as avg_packing_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pcat.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) as category_sales,
        COUNT(*) as category_quantity
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcat.product_category_name_english
),
top_category AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english as top_category
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            seller_id,
            product_category_name_english,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_sales DESC) as rn
        FROM seller_category_sales
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_quantity_sold,
    ROUND(sm.total_sales, 2) as total_sales,
    ROUND(sm.avg_item_price, 2) as avg_item_price,
    ROUND(sr.avg_review_score, 2) as avg_review_score,
    ROUND(sp.avg_packing_hours, 2) as avg_packing_hours,
    tc.top_category
FROM seller_metrics sm
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON sm.seller_id = sr.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing sp ON sm.seller_id = sp.seller_id
LEFT JOIN top_category tc ON sm.seller_id = tc.seller_id
ORDER BY sm.total_sales DESC
